define "Selections Orders List":
  if (exists "selections") then
    GetOrderFromDraftOrders("selections")
  else 
    "Service Request Item List"

define "All Provider Coverages":
  [Coverage] item where IsPayorResource(item) = false

define "All Provider Practitioners":
  [Practitioner] item where IsPayorResource(item) = false

define "All Provider PractitionerRoles":
  [PractitionerRole] item where IsPayorResource(item) = false

define "All Provider Organizations":
  [Organization] item where IsPayorResource(item) = false

define "Provider":
  if (Count("Provider Context".entry) >= 1) then 
    {
      "Patient": First(("Provider Context".entry.resource PayorResource return if (PayorResource is Patient) then PayorResource as FHIR.Patient else null as FHIR.Patient) I where I is not null),
      "Coverages": ("Provider Context".entry.resource PayorResource return if (PayorResource is Coverage) then PayorResource as FHIR.Coverage else null as FHIR.Coverage) I where I is not null,
      "Practitioners": ("Provider Context".entry.resource PayorResource return if (PayorResource is Practitioner) then PayorResource as FHIR.Practitioner else null as FHIR.Practitioner) I where I is not null,
      "PractitionerRoles": ("Provider Context".entry.resource PayorResource return if (PayorResource is PractitionerRole) then PayorResource as FHIR.PractitionerRole else null as FHIR.PractitionerRole) I where I is not null,
      "Organizations": ("Provider Context".entry.resource PayorResource return if (PayorResource is Organization) then PayorResource as FHIR.Organization else null as FHIR.Organization) I where I is not null
    }
  // This section is only for local CQL vs code plugin testing
  else
    {
      "Patient": "Provider Patient",
      "Coverages": "All Provider Coverages",
      "Practitioners": "All Provider Practitioners",
      "PractitionerRoles": "All Provider PractitionerRoles",
      "Organizations": "All Provider Organizations"
    }

define "All Payor Organizations":
  [Organization] O 
    with "All Payor Coverages" C 
    such that exists (C.payor P 
      where P.reference = 'Organization/' + O.id)

define "All Payor PractitionerRoles":
  [PractitionerRole] PR
  with "All Payor Organizations" O 
  such that PR.organization.reference = 'Organization/' + O.id

define "All Payor Practitioners":
  [Practitioner] Prac 
    with "All Payor PractitionerRoles" PR 
        such that PR.practitioner.reference = 'Practitioner/' + Prac.id

define "Payor":
  {
    "Patient": "Payor Patient",
    "Coverages": { "Payor Coverage" },
    "Practitioners": "All Payor Practitioners",
    "PractitionerRoles": "All Payor PractitionerRoles",
    "Organizations": "All Payor Organizations"
  }

define function GetOrderFromDraftOrders(list List<System.String>):
  "Service Request Item List" S 
    where exists ((list) L
      where Split(L, '/').last() = S.id.value
    )

define function "GetCoverageExtension"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>, item Tuple{"ID" System.String, "Covered" System.String, "PriorAuthNeeded" System.String, "DetailCode" System.String, "DetailText" System.String, "DetailQualification" System.String, "DetailDebugging" System.String, "DetailValue" System.String})
returns FHIR.Extension:
  Ctx."ExtensionPriorAuthNeeded"(
    requestItem,
    item."Covered", 
    item."PriorAuthNeeded", 
    item."DetailCode", 
    item."DetailText", 
    if "DebuggingEnabled" then item."DetailQualification" + Ctx.NewLine + '--- DEBUGGING ---' + Ctx.NewLine + item."DetailDebugging" else item."DetailQualification",
    item."DetailValue"
  )

define function ExtensionPriorAuthNeeded(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>, covered System.String, priorAuthRequired System.String, codeValue System.String, detailText System.String, qualification System.String, warningOrInfo System.String)
returns FHIR.Extension:
  ECI.ExtensionPriorAuthNeeded(ContextProvider."Provider Coverage".id.value, covered, priorAuthRequired, "System Generated Id"(requestItem), "Service Request Item ID"(requestItem), "Service Request Item Code"(requestItem), codeValue, detailText, qualification, warningOrInfo)

define function "QuestionnaireExtension"(priorAuthRequiredValue System.String, procedureCode System.Code)
returns FHIR.Extension:
  FHIR.Extension {
    "url": FHIR.uri { "value": 'questionnaire' },
    "value": FHIR.canonical {
      "value":
        case
          when priorAuthRequiredValue in { 'auth-needed', 'conditional' } then
            Coalesce(
              QuestionnaireRouter.GetAdaptiveQuestionnairePlanDefinition(procedureCode),
              'http://example.org/fhir/PlanDefinition/questionnaire-not-found'
            )
          else
            'http://example.org/fhir/PlanDefinition/not-applicable'
        end
    }
  }

define function GetAdaptiveQuestionnairePlanDefinition(procedureCode System.Code) 
returns System.String:
    if (procedureCode in "Sleep Study Procedure") then
        "CanonicalBase" + '/PlanDefinition/Home-Monitor-Sleep-Testing-Questionnaire'
    // else if (procedureCode in "Other Example Procedure") then
    //     "CanonicalBase" + '/Questionnaire/ASLPA1'
    else if (procedureCode in "Other Example Procedure") then
        "CanonicalBase" + '/PlanDefinition/Home-Monitor-Sleep-Testing'
    else
        null as System.String

returns FHIR.Extension:

returns FHIR.Extension:

define function IsPayorResource(resource Resource)
returns System.Boolean:
  TagExists(resource, "Payor Code")

define function TagExists(resource Resource, value System.Code)
returns System.Boolean:
  if (exists(resource.meta.tag.system)) then
    AnyTrue(
      resource.meta.tag Tag
        return 
          if Tag.system.value ~ value.system and Tag.code.value ~ value.code then 
            true 
          else 
            false
    )
  else false

define function "System Generated Id"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  Coalesce(
    (First(
      requestItem.extension E
        where E.url = 'https://smiledigitalhealth.com/priorauth/smile-crd-assertion-id'
        return E
    )).value as FHIR.string,
    "Request Id"
  )

define function "Service Request Item ID"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  // GetResourceType(requestItem) + '/' + requestItem.id.value
  if requestItem is FHIR.ServiceRequest 
    then 'ServiceRequest/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.DeviceRequest
    then 'DeviceRequest/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.NutritionOrder
    then 'NutritionOrder/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.MedicationRequest
    then 'MedicationRequest/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.VisionPrescription
    then 'VisionPrescription/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.CommunicationRequest
    then 'CommunicationRequest/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.Appointment
    then 'Appointment/' + requestItem.id.value
  else if requestItem is FHIR.Task  
    then 'Task/' + requestItem.id.value
  else 'UnknownResource'

define function "Service Request Item Code"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if (requestItem is FHIR.CommunicationRequest) then 
    FHIRHelpers.ToCode(singleton from GetCodeableConceptForCommunicationRequest(requestItem).coding)
  else 
    FHIRHelpers.ToCode(singleton from GetCode(requestItem).coding)

define function CommunicationPayloadValue(cr FHIR.CommunicationRequest):
  if exists(cr.payload p) then
    First(cr.payload p where not IsNull(p.content)).content as FHIR.string
  else null

define function GetCode(item Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>)
returns FHIR.CodeableConcept:
  if (item is FHIR.ServiceRequest) then
    if (item as FHIR.ServiceRequest).code is FHIR.CodeableConcept then 
      (item as FHIR.ServiceRequest).code as FHIR.CodeableConcept 
    else 
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.DeviceRequest) then
    if (item as FHIR.DeviceRequest).code is FHIR.CodeableConcept then
      (item as FHIR.DeviceRequest).code as FHIR.CodeableConcept
    else if (item as FHIR.DeviceRequest).code is FHIR.Reference then
      ([Device: id ~ ((item as FHIR.DeviceRequest).code as FHIR.Reference).reference]).type
    else 
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.NutritionOrder) then
    if (item as FHIR.NutritionOrder).enteralFormula.baseFormulaType is FHIR.CodeableConcept then 
      (item as FHIR.NutritionOrder).enteralFormula.baseFormulaType as FHIR.CodeableConcept
    else 
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.MedicationRequest) then 
    if (item as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication is FHIR.CodeableConcept then
      (item as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication as FHIR.CodeableConcept
    else if (item as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication is FHIR.Reference then
      ([MedicationRequest: id ~ ((item as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication as FHIR.Reference).reference])
    else 
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.VisionPrescription) then 
    if (exists ((item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).lensSpecification) LS 
      where exists ((LS.extension) E 
        where E.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/StructureDefinition/ext-billing-options'
      )
    ) then 
        First(
          from ((item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).lensSpecification) LS 
          let billingExt: First(
              (LS.extension) E
                where E.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/StructureDefinition/ext-billing-options'
                  and E.value is not null
          )
            where billingExt is not null
          return billingExt.value as FHIR.CodeableConcept
        )         
    else if exists ((item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).lensSpecification) LS
      where not exists ((LS.extension) E 
        where E.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/StructureDefinition/ext-billing-options'
      ) then
          First(
            from ((item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).lensSpecification) LS 
              where exists ((LS.extension) E 
                where E.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/StructureDefinition/ext-billing-options'
              )
              and LS.product is not null
            return 
              LS.product
          )
    else
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.Appointment) then 
    if exists ((item as FHIR.Appointment).serviceType) then 
      First((item as FHIR.Appointment).serviceType)
    else 
      null as FHIR.CodeableConcept
  else if (item is FHIR.Task) then 
    (item as FHIR.Task).code
  else null as FHIR.CodeableConcept

// CRD Logic tree
define function GetCrdResult(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
// returns Tuple{"ID" System.String, "Covered" System.String, "PriorAuthNeeded" System.String, "DetailCode" System.String, "DetailText" System.String, "DetailQualification" System.String, "DetailDebugging" System.String, "DetailValue" System.String}:
  if (ContextValidation."Insufficient or Ambiguous High"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-8"
  else if (ContextValidation."DomainResource is Empty"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-8.1"
  else if (ContextValidation."Received Provider Data Cannot be Processed"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-8.3"
  else if (MemberEligible."Not MemberEligible") then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-2"
  else if (NpiMatch."Not ProviderNpiMatch"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.1"
  else if (OrderLOBMatch."Not OrderLOBMatch") then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.2"
  else if (NpiMatch."Not LOBMatch"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.2b"
  else if (GoldCard."Is OrderGoldStatus") then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-4"
  else if (Routine."Is Routine"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"
  else if (requestItem is FHIR.CommunicationRequest) then
    GetCrdResultCommunicationRequest(requestItem)
  else if (requestItem is FHIR.Appointment) then
    GetCrdResultAppointment(requestItem)
  else if (requestItem is FHIR.MedicationRequest) then
    GetCrdResultMedicationRequest(requestItem)
  else if (not requestItem is FHIR.CommunicationRequest) then
    GetCrdResultOther(requestItem)
  else
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-UnexpectedError"

// CRD-8
define function "Insufficient or Ambiguous High"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  "Too many provider or payor coverages"
    or "Request Patient does not match Context Patient"(requestItem)
Request Patient does not match Context Patient

define function "Request Patient does not match Context Patient"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if requestItem is null then 
    false
  else
    Ctx.GetSubjectID(requestItem) !~ Ctx."Provider"."Patient".id.value

define function GetSubjectID(item Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>)
returns System.String:
  if (item is FHIR.ServiceRequest) then
    Last(Split(item.subject.reference.value, '/'))
  else if (item is FHIR.VisionPrescription or item is FHIR.NutritionOrder) then
    Last(Split(item.patient.reference.value, '/'))
  else if (item is FHIR.Appointment) then
    Last(Split(First(item.participant).actor.reference.value, '/'))
  else if (item is FHIR.Task) then 
    Last(Split(item.for.reference.value, '/'))
  else Last(Split(item.subject.reference.value, '/'))

  else if (item is FHIR.VisionPrescription) then
    if (IsNull((item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).prescriber)) then null as List<FHIR.Reference>
    else ({ (item as FHIR.VisionPrescription).prescriber }) as List<FHIR.Reference>
  else if (item is FHIR.CommunicationRequest) then 
    if (IsNull((item as FHIR.CommunicationRequest).sender)) then null as List<FHIR.Reference>
    else ({ (item as FHIR.CommunicationRequest).sender }) as List<FHIR.Reference>
  else if (item is FHIR.Appointment) then

define function GetCrdResultCommunicationRequest(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"

define function GetCrdResultAppointment(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if exists (requestItem.basedOn) then 
    if exists ((requestItem.basedOn) B
      where exists ([ServiceRequest] SR 
        where B.reference = 'ServiceRequest' + SR.id
          and (
            PriorAuthList."Is OnPriorAuthList"(SR)
            or exists ((SR.code.coding) c
              where c in "Sleep Study Procedure"
            )
          )
      )
    ) then 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
    else if exists ((requestItem.basedOn) B
      where exists ([ServiceRequest] SR 
        where B.reference = 'ServiceRequest' + SR.id
          and Routine."Is Routine"(SR)
      )
    ) then 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"
    else 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"  
  else if exists (requestItem.serviceType) then 
    if (
        PriorAuthList."Is OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)
        or exists ((Ctx.GetCode(requestItem).coding) c
          where c in "Sleep Study Procedure"
        )
    ) then
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
    else if Routine."Is Routine"(requestItem) then 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"
    else 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
  else 
    // "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-9"
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-UnexpectedError"

define function "Prior Auth Required Service Requests"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.Appointment>):
  requestItem R
    where Ctx.GetCode(R) is not null
      and exists ((Ctx.GetCode(R).coding) c 
        where c in "Prior Auth Required for Procedure Valueset"
        or c in "Prior Auth Required for Procedure Grouper"
      )

define function GetCrdResultMedicationRequest(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if BillingOptionExtensionPresent(requestItem) then 
    if (PriorAuthList."Is OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)) then
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
    else "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
  else if (((requestItem.medication as FHIR.CodeableConcept) is not null) or ((requestItem.medication as FHIR.Reference) is not null)) then
    if requestItem.medication is FHIR.CodeableConcept then 
      if (
        PriorAuthList."Not OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)
        or (
          Ctx.GetCode(requestItem) is not null
          and exists ((Ctx.GetCode(requestItem).coding) c 
            where not (c in  "Sleep Study Procedure"))
        )
      ) then 
        "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
            // if not exists (OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name") 
            // or OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name" is null then 
            //   "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.2"
            // else "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
      else if (PriorAuthList."Is OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)) then
        "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
      else if (Routine."Is Routine"(requestItem)) then 
        "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"
      else 
        "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
    else if requestItem.medication is FHIR.Reference then 
      if exists ([Medication] M 
        where (requestItem.medication as FHIR.Reference).reference = 'Medication/' + M.id 
      ) then 
          if exists ([Medication] M 
            where (requestItem.medication as FHIR.Reference).reference = 'Medication/' + M.id 
              and (
                exists ((M.code.coding) c 
                  where c in "Prior Auth Required for Procedure Valueset"
                )
                or exists ((M.code.coding) c 
                  where c in "Sleep Study Procedure"
                )
              )
          ) then 
              if not exists (OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name") 
              or OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name" is null then 
                "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.2"
              else "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
          else if exists ([Medication] M 
            where (requestItem.medication as FHIR.Reference).reference = 'Medication/' + M.id 
              and exists ((M.code.coding) c 
                where c in "Routine Procedure Valueset"
              )
          ) then 
              "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-7"
          else 
            "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
      else 
        // "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-UnexpectedError"
        "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
    else 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-UnexpectedError"
  else 
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"

define function BillingOptionExtensionPresent(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if requestItem is FHIR.MedicationRequest then 
    ((requestItem as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication) is FHIR.CodeableConcept
    and hasBillingExtension(((requestItem as FHIR.MedicationRequest).medication as FHIR.CodeableConcept).extension)
  else if requestItem is FHIR.VisionPrescription then 
    exists (((requestItem as FHIR.VisionPrescription).lensSpecification) LS 
      where hasBillingExtension(LS.extension)
    )
  else if requestItem is FHIR.ServiceRequest then 
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.ServiceRequest).extension)
  else if requestItem is FHIR.NutritionOrder then 
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.NutritionOrder).oralDiet.extension)
    or hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.NutritionOrder).enteralFormula.extension)
    or exists (
      ((requestItem as FHIR.NutritionOrder).supplement) S
        where hasBillingExtension(S.extension)
    )
  else if requestItem is FHIR.DeviceRequest then
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.DeviceRequest).extension)
  else if requestItem is FHIR.CommunicationRequest then 
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.CommunicationRequest).extension)
    or exists (((requestItem as FHIR.CommunicationRequest).payload) P
      where hasBillingExtension(P.extension)
    )
  else if requestItem is FHIR.Appointment then 
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.Appointment).extension)
  else if requestItem is FHIR.Task then 
    hasBillingExtension((requestItem as FHIR.Task).extension)
    or exists (((requestItem as FHIR.Task).input) I
      where hasBillingExtension(I.extension)
    )
  else null

define function hasBillingExtension(exts List<FHIR.Extension>) returns System.Boolean:
  exists(
    exts E 
      where E.url = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/StructureDefinition/ext-billing-options'
  )

define function "Not OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  not (("Is OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)))

define function GetCrdResultOther(requestItem Choice<FHIR.NutritionOrder, FHIR.ServiceRequest, FHIR.DeviceRequest, FHIR.MedicationRequest, FHIR.VisionPrescription, FHIR.CommunicationRequest, FHIR.Appointment, FHIR.Task>):
  if (PriorAuthList."Is OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)) then
    if not exists (OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name") 
    or OrderLOBMatch."Matching Organizations by Name" is null then 
      "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-3.2"
    else "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-5"
  else if (PriorAuthList."Not OnPriorAuthList"(requestItem)) then
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-6"
  else
    "CRD Matrix"(requestItem)."CRD-UnexpectedError"
